transcript: Speaker A: P-U-T put hota hai to C-U-T cut kyon? [If P-U-T is put, why is C-U-T cut?] Speaker B: Kyonki English ke rules har jagah badal jaate hain. [That's why the Speak Easy app explains it easily.] Speaker A: Sach mein apna thoda time bacha ke rakha hai. Kya mein abhi seekh sakta hoon? [Really, I've saved some of my time. [Great, I'll download the Speak Easy app right now.] Speaker C: Abhi Speak Easy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the Speak Easy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
